title: Pharmacy Benefit Plan Design Lineup and Sponsor Entry Requirements
content:
The Pharmacy Benefit Plan is offered to plan sponsors in six plan designs. Every design is one the sponsor elects, and a member's enrollment carries the plan design the sponsor elected. Each design belongs to one benefit design family, and each carries its own entry requirements for the sponsor.

## Design families

| Benefit design family | What it means |
|---|---|
| HSA-qualified high-deductible | A high-deductible design that qualifies the coverage for a health savings account. |
| Deductible then copays | A pharmacy deductible applies first; tier copays or coinsurance apply after it. |
| Copay only | No pharmacy deductible; tier cost share applies from the first fill. |

## Lineup and entry requirements

| Plan design | Benefit design family | Elected by the sponsor | Offered only as HSA-qualified coverage | Minimum enrolled lives |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Rx HSA Saver | HSA-qualified high-deductible | Yes | Yes | 2 |
| Northbridge Rx Basic | Deductible then copays | Yes | No | 2 |
| Northbridge Rx Value | Deductible then copays | Yes | No | 2 |
| Northbridge Rx Select | Deductible then copays | Yes | No | 51 |
| Northbridge Rx Plus | Copay only | Yes | No | 51 |
| Northbridge Rx Premier | Copay only | Yes | No | 101 |

## Reading the lineup

- **Family by design.** Northbridge Rx HSA Saver is the only HSA-qualified high-deductible design. Northbridge Rx Basic, Northbridge Rx Value and Northbridge Rx Select are deductible-then-copay designs. Northbridge Rx Plus and Northbridge Rx Premier are copay-only designs.
- **Enrolled-lives floor.** A sponsor with 2 enrolled lives meets the floor of Northbridge Rx HSA Saver, Basic and Value; a sponsor needs at least 51 enrolled lives for Northbridge Rx Select or Plus, and at least 101 for Northbridge Rx Premier.
- **HSA-qualified coverage.** Northbridge Rx HSA Saver is offered only as HSA-qualified coverage; none of the other five designs carries that restriction.

### Worked illustration (hypothetical sponsor)

A hypothetical sponsor with 75 enrolled lives clears the floor of 2 and the floor of 51, but not the floor of 101. On enrolled lives alone, it may elect any design except Northbridge Rx Premier; electing Northbridge Rx HSA Saver additionally requires the coverage to be HSA-qualified.
